svg.title: Peta Dunia: interactive world map of countries and their first-level sub-regions
svg.desc: Every country and its states, provinces and territories, each clickable. Select a region to open a chart. Keyboard: Tab to the map, arrow keys move between neighbouring regions, Page Up and Page Down jump between countries, type a name to find it, Enter or Space opens its chart, Escape closes it, plus and minus zoom, 0 resets.

path.aria-label: Aisén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Tajura' wa an Nawahi al Arba
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead
